about_the_game:
Face the demon queen Lilith in a deadly game of asymmetrical chess. Capture her pieces, but one is possessed—choose wrong, and your soul is hers. Sacrifice wisely, use cursed items, and outsmart her to save your soul.

DIFFERENT BUT FAMILIAR.

Play by the rules of chess. Keep your king alive while capturing all enemy pieces, but one is possessed. Each match is unfair, with Lilith’s forces holding the upper hand. Outsmart her to survive.

USE STRANGE ITEMS.

Use special items from captured enemy pieces to change the course of battle or even move twice in a turn.

SACRIFICE A FRIEND.

Victory demands a sacrifice. Give up your own pieces to gain powerful items.

TENSION, RISK, DECISIONS.

Every move matters. Can you outplay the devil and save your soul?

Audio Engine: FMOD Studio by Firelight Technologies Pty Ltd.
